summary: Refactors score_samples into a private _score_samples that skips input validation, and has fit() call it so feature names aren't stripped before computing offset_ via percentile. Correct, minimal, idiomatic fix that directly resolves the spurious warning.

issues.description: Order of check_is_fitted and _validate_data swapped in public score_samples: previously check_is_fitted ran first, now _validate_data(reset=False) runs first. On an unfitted estimator this may surface a different error path (missing n_features_in_), but practically negligible and matches accepted upstream behavior.

Public score_samples no longer calls check_is_fitted directly; it now relies on _score_samples for that check. The fitted-check guarantee is preserved but slightly less obvious from the public method; a brief comment could help.
